const modelWorkflowSteps = [ { icon: "⬆️", title: "Document Upload", text: "Secure multipart upload delivers the raw file to the inference service.", }, { icon: "📑", title: "Text Extraction", text: "Format-aware parsers pull readable text from PDF, DOCX, or TXT sources.", }, { icon: "🧼", title: "Text Cleaning", text: "Unicode accent stripping and lowercasing match research dataset pre-processing.", }, { icon: "✂️", title: "Sublinear TF Normalization", text: "Sublinear term frequency scaling dampens repetitive terms across long documents.", }, { icon: "📊", title: "100k TF-IDF Vectorization", text: "Sparse vectorization projects text into a high-dimensional 100,000 unigram/bigram feature space.", }, { icon: "⚖️", title: "Linear Feature Attribution", text: "Exact mathematical weighting (x_j * w_c,j) calculates the most decisive lexical tokens.", }, { icon: "🧠", title: "LinearSVC Classification", text: "Hyperplane decision scores determine the top class and runner-up with high margin.", }, { icon: "🎯", title: "Domain Prediction", text: "The winning category and decision margin are serialized back to the React dashboard with storage metadata.", }, { icon: "📁", title: "Automatic Folder Sorting", text: "The file is moved into the predicted domain folder under ~/Desktop/SortedDocuments.", }, ]; function Home() { const navigate = useNavigate(); const location = useLocation(); const featuresRef = useRef(null); useEffect(() => { if (location.hash === "#about") { const el = document.getElementById("about"); if (el) { requestAnimationFrame(() => el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" })); } } }, [location.hash, location.pathname]); const handleLearnMore = () => { featuresRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" }); Model details

What happens under the hood

  • The system uses TF-IDF vectorization to convert textual content into numerical feature vectors that machine learning models can consume.
  • TF-IDF assigns higher importance to meaningful domain-specific words that are frequent in the document yet comparatively rare across the broader corpus.
  • A Naive Bayes classifier estimates probability distributions of words conditioned on each document category learned during training.
  • The classifier predicts the most probable domain by combining those likelihoods with priors, producing an interpretable label plus a confidence signal from class probabilities.
  • After prediction, the FastAPI backend automatically sorts the uploaded file into the matching local desktop folder so the UI can display a concrete storage path.
About

Real-world usefulness & intelligent automation

Why it matters

Knowledge workers routinely drown in mixed-format inboxes. This project demonstrates how lightweight NLP plus disciplined folder hygiene can scale personal organization without manual tagging.

Data mining lens

Every upload exercises a full mining stack: selection, cleaning, transformation, modeling, and evaluation through confidence and lexical diagnostics surfaced on the results dashboard.

Presentation ready

The interface keeps the pastel DocuSense palette, soft glass cards, and smooth motion so judges or interviewers immediately read it as a modern AI SaaS experience—not a homework script.

AI-powered cross-domain document classification and auto-sorting system for demos, vivas, and portfolio storytelling.
